name: io.github.Phosse136/cyphos-guard
description: Spending guardrails for AI agents: on-chain limits, passkey approval above them. Testnet.

environmentVariables.name: CYPHOS_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's own throwaway testnet key (create one with: npx @cyphos-guard/cli agent new). Holds gas only.

environmentVariables.name: CYPHOS_POLICY_SERVICE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Policy service URL, e.g. https://app.cyphosguard.com/api (default http://127.0.0.1:8787)

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: live = Base Sepolia, fork = local fork (default fork)

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base Sepolia RPC for NETWORK=live (default https://sepolia.base.org)
